verdict.rationale: DeepSeek documents a public pricing page (api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) with per-model tables, and community users discuss its low and reduced API prices, so self-serve public pricing is implied. However, no evidence item actually quotes per-token rates or confirms that every current model is listed. Missing for 10: verbatim per-token input/output prices, confirmation that all current models (V4 Flash/Pro, vision model) are priced on the page, and independent corroboration of the published rates.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every current model without talking to sales

citations.quote: pricing page tables show per-model concurrency, e.g. 2500/500
